faq.openless-is-a-completely-free-open: OpenLess is a completely free, open-source AI voice input app. It turns speech into text and helps refine your wording. Choose your speech recognition and text processing services, and use a personal dictionary, style packs, and history to make writing feel more like you.
faq.typeless-offers-a-free-plan-and: Typeless offers a free plan and paid subscriptions. The OpenLess app is completely free and open source, with no app subscription fee. You can explore the code, contribute improvements, and choose the speech recognition and text processing services that suit you.
faq.if-you-use-third-party-cloud: If you use third-party cloud models, their providers may charge for usage. The OpenLess app itself does not charge a subscription fee.
faq.how-does-openless-compare-with-typel: How does OpenLess compare with Typeless? Is it free?
faq.add-frequently-used-words-from-your: Add frequently used words from your history to your dictionary, define tone and formatting with style packs, and use context from the current app to refine your wording. Choose an approach that fits whether you’re writing an email, talking to AI, or taking notes.
faq.vocabulary-learning-and-cursor-conte: Vocabulary learning and cursor context are opt-in. New word suggestions are added to your dictionary only after you confirm them. When context is enabled, OpenLess uses text near your cursor to better understand what you mean.
faq.how-does-it-adapt-to-my: How does it adapt to my habits and different apps?
faq.choose-download-openless-then-select: Choose Download OpenLess, then select your device and chip. We look for the most recently published stable release with a matching installer. You can also opt in to preview builds.
faq.how-do-i-get-the-latest: How do I get the latest version?
faq.yes-you-can-configure-and-manage: Yes. You can configure and manage speech recognition and text processing services in the app. See the repository documentation for supported providers and setup instructions.
faq.can-i-choose-my-speech-and: Can I choose my speech and text processing services?
